original_archive_reference: The National Archives AIR 15/162, Table I
reproduced_in: Andrew W. A. Hendrie, Coastal Command 1939–1945: The Cinderella Service (University of Kent PhD thesis, 2004), Appendix 21
force: RAF Coastal Command, including Commonwealth/Dominion and Allied personnel in RAF posting/disposal
geographic_scope_warning: Coastal Command command-wide, not exclusively European mainland; global maritime air operations and units, potentially allied posted personnel
critical_cautions: Original Table I casualties were subsequently amended through 31 May 1947; individuals initially missing or captured and later killed are entered in the killed column, not double-counted as missing or prisoner.
Parentheses are persons reported safe later but still INCLUDED in the adjacent missing or POW totals: not separate additional cases or casualties.
8,180 aircrew killed includes navigators, observers, air gunners, wireless operators and other aircrew, not 8,180 pilot deaths.
The natural-cause death row of 23+224=247 is separate from the table of 8,874 killed and must be labelled distinctly.
The reproduced British government archival table is retained in eight normalized derived factual rows, not a copy of the large copyrighted dissertation.
Host RAF/CW/Allied personnel may overlap national casualty counts. No directly comparable theater-filtered personnel total or monthly unit series is provided here.
